Mission Local reported that Alemany Farm, which grows more than 30,000 pounds of free produce annually and helps feed about 700 families a week, faced a $100,000–$150,000 budget gap after one-time city funding ran out. The farm paused paid apprenticeships, reduced staff hours and started a $200,000 fundraising campaign as it tried to stay open. The article noted that the farm’s future was uncertain amid city budget cuts.
